text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy renews call for unconditional talks and U.S. middle east peace coordinater Dennis Ross prepars to visit the region next week.
- Observers say: "Syria does not bargain on the return of the Golan."
- France says Israel is responsible for the deadlock of the peace process.

- Lebanon's Parliament Speaker Nabih Berri calls on the Lebanese to continue national reconciliation moves and says Israeli withdrawal from south Lebanon and the Golan Heights is the most important issue for Lebanon.
- Prime Minister Mahmoud Zu'bi heads a meeting to discuss the best way for investing in railroad lines in Syria.
- Syrian Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara discussed developments of the Middle East peace process with director-general of the Syrian-Lebanese Supreme Council.
